segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, internal prep before Northgate joins at half past. Let's get aligned on terms.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Their latest draft asks for exclusivity in the healthcare vertical for three years.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: That's a non-starter. We have two healthcare resellers already.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Agreed. What can we offer instead?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Preferred partner status and a higher referral fee for the first year.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'd also offer co-marketing, it costs us little.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Good. What's the history on the dispute with their former subsidiary?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Our outside counsel thinks we have a strong breach-of-contract claim against them for the API usage overages, but her advice was to hold the lawsuit as leverage and not file until after this deal is signed. She also said not to put anything about the dispute in email.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: And she wants us to preserve the usage logs now, because if we file, their first move will be to argue we never sent proper notice.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay. So we don't raise it today.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Next item, the integration timeline. They want a live integration by Q4.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Engineering estimates eight to ten weeks once the API spec is final.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Then let's commit to a beta in October and GA by mid-November.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I'll also ask for a named technical contact on their side. Last time we had a different person every call.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Good. And let's push for quarterly business reviews, not monthly.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: They'll accept that, their team is stretched.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Alright, take five and we'll reconvene when they join.
